Здесь простыми словами описано, какие да: It describes in simple terms what data GENESIS receives, why it is needed, where it is stored and how the user can delete it or revoke access to an account.
Для экономии запросов к Google сайт и пр: To save requests to Google, the site and application use a common account server cache. Events, tasks and lists in this cache are encrypted by Sodium secretbox with a private server key and isolated by account and current permissions. When services are disabled, an additional account or a GENESIS account is deleted, the corresponding cache is deleted. Personal changes are sent to Google immediately; incoming changes are checked no more than once every 15 minutes during active use, full reconciliation - once a day. The content of shared tasks, comments, and the log is also encrypted at rest; the server decrypts it only for authorized processing. This is not end-to-end encryption.
Личное пространство связано с подтверждё: Personal space is associated with a verified Google account. An email address match is not considered proof of ownership and does not trigger a merge. Additional Google accounts are connected only through a separate official authorization and are used within the limits of the permissions you select.
При подключении Google Calendar и Google: When you connect Google Calendar and Google Tasks, entries are synchronized with the selected Google accounts within the limits of the permissions you have granted. Calendar notifications are delivered by Google Calendar. Local GENESIS notifications on your phone depend on your device settings.

После входа через Google задачи могут хр: Once you've signed in with Google, tasks can be stored in Google Calendar and Google Tasks if you've enabled the appropriate permissions separately. Without connecting these services, some of the data remains in the local copy of the device and in the encrypted GENESIS space. Signing in by itself does not enable Google calendar or tasks.
Google даёт отдельные копии подключённых: Google provides separate copies of connected entries in the corresponding calendars. If the network fails, changes may wait on the device to be sent; Exiting, clearing app data, or losing the device before successful syncing may remove such changes. Deleting or changing an entry can be synchronized to other devices; a backup copy does not guarantee the recovery of a single accidentally deleted task. Hacking of a device, account or server, program errors and unavailability of an external provider also create the risk of accessing data or losing an up-to-date copy. For important records, keep your own independent export or copy.
Доступ подключается отдельно после входа: Access is activated separately after logging in and only with your consent. Категории, проекты, подпроекты, настройк: Categories, projects, subprojects, settings and tracker data are encrypted in the application using the AES-GCM algorithm before being sent to the server. The space key is stored separately on a private server side in encrypted form and is issued only to a secure session after a confirmed login. This allows you to open data on a new device without a separate recovery code, but means that protecting the server and session is also important. This is not end-to-end device-to-device encryption.
Сервер хранит адрес электронной почты, д: The server stores email address, dates of registration and last activity, number of logins and numeric counters of projects, tasks, habits and synchronized events. When you request an Android APK download from an authorized account, the number and dates of such requests are stored; anonymous or direct uploads cannot be associated with an account. When an Android application contacts the server, it reports the version and a random installation identifier; the server stores the time of the last connection and the result of the last synchronization attempt without task contents. The administrator can see these indicators next to the account address for support and diagnostics. The information is deleted along with the account. The server code processes the text of tasks during synchronization, so there is no absolute inaccessibility of data to the service operator.
Когда авторизованный пользователь открыв: When an authorized user opens a menu item, subsection, or calendar option on a website or Android application, GENESIS records the feature ID, client type (website or Android), number of opens, and first and last open times in a counter associated with their account. The content of tasks and projects, text of speech, selected cards, mood and sleep are not included in these statistics. The administrative table shows the total openings and the number of users for each function; the number of users who have turned off a section, subsection or calendar is calculated from the current settings. The "Unopened" column indicates that there has been no recorded event since the beginning of such a count, rather than proof that the function was never used. The data is used to improve the interface, is not transferred to advertising networks and is stored until the account is deleted.
